articles.text: MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Nǐmen chǎngde jiāshǔ sùshè dōu hěn gānjìng, yě dōu hěn xīn ma!
AMERICAN VISITOR: Your factory's family housing is all very clean and very new!
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Wǒmen chǎngde sùshè hái suàn bú cuò, chǎng lǐngdǎo shuō hái yào zài gài jǐdòng xīn sùshè ne!
PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: Our factory's housing is pretty good. The factory's leadership says that a few more buildings are going to be built, too.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Sùshè hái bú gòu ma?
AMERICAN VISITOR: Isn't there enough housing yet?
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Bú gòu, wǒmen chǎng lí chéngli zhēn yuǎn, zhù zài chénglide zhígōng shàng xià bān hái zhēn shi yǒu diǎnr bù fāngbian.
PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: No. Our factory is very far from the city. It's really pretty inconvenient for the staff and workers who live in the city to get to and from work.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Xiànzài hái yǒu hěn duō gōngren zhù zài chéngli ma?
AMERICAN VISITOR: Are there still a lot of workers living in town?
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Yǒu, hái yǒu bù shǎo jìshu rényuán yě zhù zài chéngli.
PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: Yes, and there are also a lot of technical personnel living in town.

SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Tèbié shi nèixiē bú zài yíge chǎng gōngzuòde shuāngzhígōng, shàng xià bān jǐ gōnggòng qìchē, bǐ shàng bān hái lèi, shíjiān chángle zěnme xíng ne? Suǒyǐ wǒmen zài máng yě děi kuài yìdiǎnr duō gài jǐdòng zhígōng sùshè.

PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: Especially for those working couples who don't work in the same factory, wrestling with the buses before and after work is even more tiring than work itself. How can you expect them to keep that up very long? So no matter how busy we are, we have to put up a few new buildings for staff and workers.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Ràng tāmen dōu bān dào chéngwài lái zhù?
AMERICAN VISITOR: And have them all move from the town out here?
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Bù, tāmen kěyi zhù zài sùshèli, měige Xīngqīliù huí jiā jiù xíng le. Zhèiyangr, Xīngqīyī dào Xīngqīwǔde yèyú shíjiān tāmen jiù kěyi zài wǒmen chǎngde yèdàxué xuǎn kè, nà duō hǎo!

PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: No, they can stay in the dormitories here, but go home every Saturday. That way, from Monday to Friday, they can take courses after work at our factory's evening university, which would be great.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Xiànzài zài yèdàxué niàn shūde gōngren duō ma?
AMERICAN VISITOR: Are there a lot of workers taking classes at the evening university now?

SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Bù shǎo, chàbuduō yǒu yíbàn yǐshàngde qīngnián gōngren dōu xuǎn yìmén, liǎngmén kè. Tīng lǎoshīmen shuō, xiànzài xuéshēngde shuǐpíng dōu kuài yào gǎnshang Wénhuà Dà Gémìng yǐqiánde xuéshēng la!

PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: Quite a few. Roughly over half of our young workers take one or two courses. According to the teachers, the students' level has practically caught up with the pre-Cultural Revolution level.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Kěxī wǒde shíjiān ānpáide tài jǐn, yàoburán wǒ hái zhēn xiǎng zài yèdàxué tīngting kè ne.
AMERICAN VISITOR: It's too bad that I have such a tight schedule, otherwise I'd really like to sit in on some evening university classes.
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Nín méi shíjiān tīng kè, qù hé yèdàxuéde lǎoshī tántan yě hǎo ma.
PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: If you don't have time to sit in on any classes, why not go talk with some of the evening university's teachers?
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Ǹg, kěyi tīng tāmen jièshao jièshao qíngkuàng.
AMERICAN VISITOR: Mm, I could get some information about the university from them.
SÙSHÈ FÙZÉRÉN: Zǒu, wǒmen dào bàngōngshì qu, qǐng dǎoyóu tóngzhì xiànzài jiù péi nǐmen qù yítàng.
PERSON IN CHARGE OF THE HOUSING: Let's go to the office and ask the guide to accompany us right now.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Hǎo, zǒu.
AMERICAN VISITOR: Okay, let's go.
